🇨🇳 中文说明"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"⭐ If you like this plugin, please star it on GitHub — it shows me that the plugin is useful to you a"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"nd motivates me to keep developing it."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"🐛 If you find a bug or would like to request a feature, open a GitHub issue in any language — I will"},{"id":"p7s2","text":" review your proposal and implement useful suggestions in a future plugin version."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## ⚡ Overview & The Problem"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"**ClinePass** (`https://cline.bot`) is a subscription service providing developers with 2–5x higher "},{"id":"p9s2","text":"rate limits across premier open-weights coding and reasoning models through a single OpenAI-compatib"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"le endpoint (`https://api.cline.bot/api/v1`)."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"Integrating ClinePass into DeepSeek Harness (DSH) natively poses key challenges:
1. **No `/v1/models"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"` Discovery**: `GET /v1/models` on `api.cline.bot` returns `404 Not Found`. Dynamic discovery fails "},{"id":"p10s3","text":"silently or leaves the provider with 0 models.
2. **Model Identifier Formats**: Models require the s"},{"id":"p10s4","text":"pecific prefix `cline-pass/` (e.g. `cline-pass/deepseek-v4.1-flash`, `cline-pass/kimi-k3`).
3. **Quo"},{"id":"p10s5","text":"ta Tracking**: Rolling 5-hour and weekly limits need clear in-browser visualization.
4. **Credential"},{"id":"p10s6","text":" Security**: Storing API keys directly in plain settings is insecure."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"**`@goodandready/dsh-clinebot`** provides a complete solution:
* 🚀 **One-Click In-App Updater**: Upg"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"rade `@goodandready/dsh-clinebot` directly from the DSH UI or trigger secure loopback updates via `/"},{"id":"p11s3","text":"dsh-clinebot/update`.
* ⚡ **SWR Quota & Health Caching**: Instantaneous response time (<2ms) on stat"},{"id":"p11s4","text":"us queries with background revalidation.
* 🔀 **Smart Quota-Aware Failover**: Automatic multi-account"},{"id":"p11s5","text":" rotation on stream HTTP 429 and exhausted quota (with 30s storm protection; current request is not "},{"id":"p11s6","text":"retried, subsequent chat requests use the next available account).
* 🖥️ **Plugin configuration page*"},{"id":"p11s7","text":"*: Open the installed ClineBot plugin and choose configure. The page shows the credential name, mode"},{"id":"p11s8","text":"ls, quota, and accounts. It is not a separate sidebar section.
* 🔄 **Dynamic Subscription Model Sync"},{"id":"p11s9","text":"**: Automatically pulls real models included in your ClinePass plan directly from `GET /api/v1/users"},{"id":"p11s10","text":"/me/plan` with one-click DSH provider sync. Only actual plan models are registered in DSH, while the"},{"id":"p11s11","text":" built-in catalog serves as a rich properties reference and fallback when unsynced.
* ⚠️ **Quota Exh"},{"id":"p11s12","text":"austion Alerts**: Real-time visual warning banners when 5-hour rolling limit reaches 80% (warning) a"},{"id":"p11s13","text":"nd 95% (exhausted), complete with countdown to reset.
